purpose: Public research inputs and sensitivity scenarios; not authenticated account fees

robinhood_crypto_exchange_routing.note: Trailing 30-day executed exchange-routing volume, not account balance. Model each fill at its then-current tier; do not apply a future tier retroactively. The market-maker route has no commission, but its execution cost is not zero and requires account quotes. Robinhood books were not measured in the Coinbase feasibility snapshot.

coinbase_advanced_spot.status: account tier unavailable; complete current schedule requires sign-in
coinbase_advanced_spot.note: These are explicit cost sensitivity assumptions, not a verified average or upper bound. Do not substitute Coinbase Exchange, consumer buy/sell, or non-US derivatives rates. No assumed maker fills or automatic fee discounts.

coinbase_us_futures.status: public advertised minimum, not a verified current account rate
coinbase_us_futures.note: Published disclosure includes exchange, clearing and NFA fees. Model max(notional fee, contract minimum), not their sum. The 5 and 10 bps scenarios are assumptions; the headline 2 bps is not guaranteed. Fees apply separately on entry and exit. Funding is additional.
